activities.title: Rosa and the Snow
activities.directions: Listen to the story. Tap why Rosa puts on a coat, a hat and boots.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha el cuento. Toca por qué Rosa se pone abrigo, gorro y botas.

activities.promptEs: ¿Por qué Rosa se pone ropa abrigada?
activities.script: It snowed all night. Rosa looks out the window. Everything is white. She puts on her coat, her hat and her boots. Then she goes out to play.
vocabulary: soft white flakes of frozen water
nieve: copos blancos y suaves de agua congelada
strong shoes that keep your feet dry
botas: zapatos fuertes que mantienen secos los pies
activities.correct: It snowed, so it is cold. Warm clothes keep Rosa warm.
